scope: Unchanged guided connected bike and static rider prerequisites. No articulated integration, physical calibration, target-hardware or real-time acceptance.

method.timing: Monotonic wall time. Run includes model build, integration, guards, observations and result materialization; JSON/Node clone measured separately.
method.micro: Batch loop and checksum overhead included; no overhead subtraction. Native forward fixture is static, not a trajectory.
method.concurrency: Serial in one process; operator must avoid concurrent workloads. Shared host contention is uncontrolled.
method.memory: Before/after snapshots and cumulative process RSS high-water, not isolated per-case peaks or leak evidence.
method.profile: Use --profile under node --cpu-prof separately; never combine its timing with the unprofiled samples.
